Short, spiky charcoal grey hair with a jagged parting. Sharp, narrow amber gold eyes with a piercing expression. Apparent age is mid-twenties with a mature, stern facial structure. Lean, athletic build with broad shoulders. Wears a high-collared midnight black sleeveless tunic paired with dark slate trousers and a wide crimson silk sash around the waist. Signature details include a jagged black ink tattoo extending from the right collarbone up to the jawline and a single silver hoop earring in the left ear.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
